title: Full Contact Fairlight ADF: native supervisor stack and default Copper startup
status: PASS for bounded crack intro, HAM photograph, title, disk-two swap and fight through 24000 fields
scope: Bounded native compatibility only. Full game completion, audio quality, hardware correctness and host performance acceptance remain unverified. No engine timing, CPU package, host OS shim or package-publication changes.

rom.scope: 68000 PAL OCS A500; native DF0; custom boot blocks, DOS0/DOS1 startup, native CON and interactive boot CLI; optional 512 KiB slow RAM bounce test

compositionProvenance.note: Unchanged frozen C# compiled root; rebuilt native resident/bootstrap and compiler-owned stack-setup relocation at $FE2878. No guest CPU/RAM injection.

sourceProvenance.note: Reused unchanged frozen C# compiled root (448542 code bytes) and ten other manifest inputs. The rebuilt native emitter replaces one six-byte compiler-owned stack primitive at $FE2878, installs the native block and renews the checksum. The preceding provenance still applies to frozen producers; this is an observed source/binary overlay, not reproduction from one clean source commit.

precedingProvenance.note: Only the Exec managed producer changes relative to the preceding qualified frozen input set. The remaining frozen producers retain that record's concurrent-source provenance. This is an observed binary/source overlay, not reproduction from one clean source commit.

Shared-checkout producer identities, not a clean-commit reproduction claim. The original C# producer snapshot includes concurrent console/DOS edits excluded from the graphics commits. The final rebuild substitutes Exec producer 79D210... and the final standalone native emitter; all other managed C# producers remain frozen.

failures.symptom: Misaligned HAM palette and clipped title
failures.cause: Six-byte exception frame plus sixty saved-register bytes overlap the decompression buffer.
failures.fix: Select fitted A501 stack before the live C# chain; reserve $C7DFF0-$C7FFF0, publish bounds/checksum and return $70000-$78000 Chip reserve. Keep the Chip-only fallback. Physical memory limits remain intact.

failures.symptom: Solid-blue Fairlight intro after stack repair
failures.cause: The polling intro assumes the OS already enables COPEN. On exit it restores GfxBase+$26 (gb_copinit), previously zero.
failures.fix: Allocate and publish an eight-byte Chip Copper list (BPLCON0=0, end WAIT), install it and enable master/Copper/blitter DMA with $82C0. No VBlank interrupt policy change.
